result.summary: The page is largely intact; horizontal carousel clipping and the card cut off at the bottom are intentional scroll behavior. One visible content defect stands out: a discount badge reading '-0%'.

issues.description: The promo badge on the lower card displays '-0%', a nonsensical discount value that looks like a formatting or data error rather than a real offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero, or render the actual discount value (e.g. '-10%') so the badge never shows '-0%'.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a near-white background, giving very low contrast and making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) against the search field background.
